newsitem.title: UK: UK shares rebound after Wall Street recovery.
newsitem.headline: UK shares rebound after Wall Street recovery.

text.p: UK stocks jumped higher at the outset on Monday after a bounce-back by Wall Street on Friday, sparking a recovery in Asian markets which bore the brunt of Friday's global market turmoil.

The FTSE 100 index was up 25.7 points at 3,988.7 by 0854 GMT, with gaining shares outpacing decliners 11-to-one. British Aerospace and GEC were among the early gainers amid renewed hopes for international defence deals.
Yet traders said gains were likely to be capped as talk of an early election revived following the latest outbreak of tensions in the ruling Conservative Party.
